description: Medical specialty dealing with the prevention, diagnosis, and non-surgical treatment of adult internal diseases, systemic infections, and acute common conditions.
urgencyAssessment: First point of medical triage for undifferentiated symptoms.

description: Medical specialty dealing with disorders of the heart and blood vessels, coronary artery disease, heart failure, and arrhythmias.
urgencyAssessment: Sudden onset chest pain, arm radiating numbness, and acute shortness of breath demand emergency care.

description: Specialty focusing on diseases affecting the respiratory tract, lungs, and bronchial tubes.
urgencyAssessment: Severe dyspnea, cyanosis, and falling blood oxygen saturation require urgent clinical attention.

description: Specialty focused on the endocrine system, hormones, thyroid glands, adrenal glands, and metabolic regulation.
urgencyAssessment: Diabetic ketoacidosis or thyroid storm represent metabolic emergencies.

description: Medical specialty dealing with disorders of the central and peripheral nervous system, brain, and spinal cord.
urgencyAssessment: Sudden facial drooping, speech slurring, and unilateral motor weakness require immediate stroke protocol.

description: Focuses on the digestive system, stomach, intestines, liver, gallbladder, and pancreas.
urgencyAssessment: Hematemesis, black tarry stools, or severe acute abdominal rigidity are medical emergencies.

description: Specialty dedicated to diagnosing and therapy of rheumatic diseases, arthritis, musculoskeletal conditions, and autoimmune disorders.
urgencyAssessment: Joint erythema with high fever and sudden effusion indicates potential septic arthritis.

description: Branch of medicine dealing with the skin, nails, hair, cutaneous pathologies, and cosmetic skin disorders.
urgencyAssessment: Rapidly spreading rash with fever or mucosal involvement indicates severe cutaneous adverse reaction.

description: Specialized branch addressing viral, bacterial, fungal, and parasitic infections including tropical fevers.
urgencyAssessment: Septic shock, persistent high fevers, and thrombocytopenia require critical hospital management.

description: Surgical and rehabilitation specialty for bones, joints, ligaments, tendons, and spine biomechanics.
urgencyAssessment: Compound fractures, neurovascular compromise, and joint dislocation necessitate emergency intervention.

description: Care for vision, ocular health, ear, nose, throat, and sinus systems.
urgencyAssessment: Sudden loss of vision, severe eye pain with haloes, or airway-compromised throat swelling are emergencies.

description: Specialty managing renal function, kidney stones, urinary tract infections, and fluid-electrolyte balance.
urgencyAssessment: Anuria, acute renal colic, and severe gross hematuria require urgent urological assessment.
